description: This file contains legacy functions for the TestLink open source test management system, primarily dealing with execution results, issue management, and attachments. It includes functions for creating results menus, writing execution data to the database, managing bugs and issues linked to test executions, and handling file attachments.

classes.name: tlAttachmentRepository
classes.description: Class responsible for managing file attachments related to test executions and steps.

classes.name: testcase
classes.description: Class managing test case data and relation to executions.

classes.name: cfield_mgr
classes.description: Class managing custom fields associated with test cases.

classes.name: testproject
classes.description: Class managing test project data and options.

methods.name: createResultsMenu
methods.description: Constructs a dropdown menu array of test result statuses, excluding specified statuses if provided.

methods.name: write_execution
methods.description: Persists test execution results and related data into the database, including handling attachments and custom fields.

methods.name: write_execution_bug
methods.description: Associates or removes bug links with specific test execution steps in the database.

methods.name: get_bugs_for_exec
methods.description: Retrieves bugs linked to a specific execution from an external bug tracker.

methods.name: get_execution
methods.description: Fetches detailed information about a specific test execution.

methods.name: delete_execution
methods.description: Removes a test execution and all its related data from the database.

methods.name: updateExecutionNotes
methods.description: Updates the notes/comments attached to a specific test execution record.

methods.name: getBugsForExecutions
methods.description: Retrieves bug data linked to multiple executions.

methods.name: addIssue
methods.description: Creates a new issue linked to a test execution, optionally adding bugs to an external tracker and managing attachments.

methods.name: copyIssues
methods.description: Copies bug associations from one execution to another in the database.

methods.name: generateIssueText
methods.description: Generates detailed issue descriptions and metadata for bug reporting, including dynamic content replacements.

methods.name: getIssueTrackerMetaData
methods.description: Fetches selectable issue types, components, priorities, and versions from the issue tracker configuration.

methods.name: completeCreateIssue
methods.description: Populates execution signature data into issue creation context.

methods.name: completeIssueForStep
methods.description: Populates step-specific issue data into the issue creation context.

methods.name: addAttachmentsToExec
methods.description: Handles uploading and associating file attachments to a specific test execution or step.
